name: OMH SCIENCE Group Co., Ltd
summary: OMH SCIENCE Group Co., Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sales of intelligent production systems, intelligent logistics storage systems, intelligent parking systems, and spare parts in China and internationally. The company offers intelligent manufacturing system EPC, intelligent production solution; intelligent warehousing solutions; intelligent distribution solution; intelligent sorting solutions; and intelligent 3D parking solutions. It also provides stackers, hoist, forklift and stacking AGV, cross belt sorter, conveyor, intelligent stereo garage, and parking robot; and OMH cloud platform, OMH SCMP, modularization management, WMS, WMC, and monitoring system.
